integration_vocabulary.local-integrated: Ancestor of integ/beta-2026-11-14 HEAD (git merge-base --is-ancestor), reached by fast-forward; not pushed, not on Beta, not device-verified.
integration_vocabulary.isolated: Commit only on its own local branch/worktree; not an ancestor of integ HEAD; awaits a separate safe fast-forward task.
integration_vocabulary.rejected: Commit reviewed and deliberately NOT to be integrated (e.g. security regression); kept on its branch for evidence; replaced_by names the substitute.
integration_vocabulary.blocked: Cannot proceed without a missing prerequisite (user approval, real recorded provider data, paid/external call approval, licence decision).
integration_vocabulary.none: Read-only / no-change task; nothing to integrate.
